# Pull request

## What (one scope per PR)

## Evidence

- [ ] Reproduced first (defect PRs) / spec reference (ruleset PRs):
- [ ] Regression test added (or reason documented):
- [ ] Full suite green (`python3 -m pytest tests/ -q`):
- [ ] Goldens untouched (or migration documented per O08):

## Behavior impact

- [ ] No public behavior change
- [ ] Behavior change (describe + CHANGELOG entry + version bump per VERSIONING.md):

## Checklist

- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or justification):
- [ ] No FIDE endorsement/compliance claims added:
- [ ] Tree clean (no `dist/`, baselines, caches):
